text:
Marco: quick ask — can someone run a skewed-read throughput sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S?
Need batch-size x seq-len heatmap + p50/p95/p99 latency and GPU util/power traces. It looks like long KV-cache hits tank throughput for some SKUs.

Repo bench command is ./bench/sku_sweep.py --model=redwood-small --out=./artifacts/sku_sweep.csv. Prefer runs with warmup=300s and at least 5 samples per point. Can we get base fp16 + int8 where available? :pray:

Priya: what target QPS/clients should we emulate? also, do you want the kernel-selection logs (rlc) and nvprof traces?

Marco: target is scaled to ~8k tok/s sustained for the model (roughly 200 reqs/s @ 40 tok/req). yes to kernel logs and nvprof where possible — they helped last time. include env: CUDA=12.1, driver=535.113. Use same input distribution as long-kv-workload (see ./bench/inputs/long_kv.json).

Alex: I can take H100 + L40S tonight. Will run fp16 + int8 for both. Command I’ll use:```bash
./bench/sku_sweep.py --model=redwood-small --seqs=256,512,1024 --batches=1,2,4,8 --warmup=300 --samples=5 --quant=int8,fp16 --out=artifacts/alex_1912345678.csv
```
I’ll also capture nvidia-smi sampling and perf counters via perf.

Sasha: small note: L40S on node-node42 had thermal throttling last week under long sustained runs. add a 60s cooldown between big batches or run on node44 if you can. Also consider a short warm-cache run (seq=64) before sweeps to populate KV.

BenchBot: queued job #4321 for Alex (H100,L40S). Starting agent on node44. ETA ~22:30 UTC. Will upload results to /bench-results/1912345678/ when done. :robot_face:

Kim: please ensure we capture p50/p95/p99 and GPU duty cycle + power (sampled at 1s). Also tag eng-sre if any machine hits >95% power cap or OOMs. Can we add per-request token emission times (for microburst analysis)?

Marco: yes — include per-request token timing CSV and the kernel-selection log. If any run diverges significantly, leave the raw logs and dont re-run until we triage.

Alex: quick interim — H100 fp16 run finished on node44: p50=78ms, p95=210ms, p99=420ms, avg GPU util=62%, avg power=210W. Uploading CSV + nvprof now to /bench-results/1912345678/h100_fp16.zip. Starting int8 next. L40S queued on node44 with 60s cooldown between batches per Sasha.

Priya: awesome, thanks Alex — when int8 is done can you also dump kernel-selection diff vs fp16? I want to see any fallback kernels.

Marco: thanks all. once we have all three SKUs I’ll sketch cost/latency curves for the Optimize team. tagging @eng-sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
